Please help! Looking for a chocolate company that used to set up tables in the Chadds Ford Wegmans pre-pandemic.

I remember seeing them a few times around Christmas. I recall that they had a huge variety in flavors, and you could choose what flavors they’d put in a box for you. The box was clear and rectangular, and the chocolates were shaped like single kit-kat pieces. The flavors were all really interesting. I think the company’s name had something to do with a moon? Any help you can give would be awesome! Thank you in advance! 4

Not sure if it's different there than here, but pre-pandemic what you're describing sounds like the booth Wegman's set up on their own, not a private company. Yours could be different for sure. I haven't seen the booth in years, but can still get the chocolates in the fancy-pants section alongside olives and cheeses and macaroons.

Hi! I’m fairly certain it was a private company, because I haven’t been able to find these chocolates in the store otherwise. It may be different depending on the area though, like you said.

I remember a company setting up in Downingtown and Malvern Wegmans during the holidays, prepandemic. I wouldn't be surprised if they were all the same company. They were a separate company from Wegmans. I'll look at the 'fancy pants' section (hahaha) for the chocolates next time I'm in the store.

Yes! I’m sure it was the same company - so glad you remember them too. Please let me know if you find anything!

[removed]

Why don't you just ask the Chadds Ford Wegmans?

I did, they weren’t able to give me an answer. I think a lot of the staff are post-pandemic hires, so I’m not super surprised that they’re not sure.

Don’t know for sure but here’s a guess…There’s a fancy brand they sell in the gift shop at Longwood. Based in West Chester Éclat Chocolate

Definitely not Éclat - I love them haha

Gertrude Hawk?

No, I don’t think so, but good suggestion. It was definitely a brand I hadn’t seen outside of this set-up
